messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up team 1: ACME dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 08:00 PDT. Need final confirmation on quotas, autoscale knobs, and the load run schedule. Short checklist below. @raj_infra @leo_sre @anya_ops please confirm.

maria_cs: Checklist: reserve pool, set soft quota during shadow, hard quota post-validation, autoscale policy, 20m shadow at 60% peak, 10m smoke at 100%, capture traces + cost, tag all runs `acme-seatbelt-2026`.

raj_infra: Pool reservation in progress. Requesting soft_quota=1800 concurrent tokens, hard_quota=2300 with 10min burst window. Will handoff pool id once created.

leo_sre: Prefer soft cap during shadow. Autoscale: min_instances=2, max_instances=30, scale_cooldown=75s, target_p95_ms=320. Fallback: route to quant-small if p95 > 850ms for 2min straight.

anya_ops: Product wants exports for renewal deck. Please ensure metrics include p95, p99, token_cost_delta, fallback_count, and cache_hit_ratio. Tag runs for CSV export.

maria_cs: Can you paste the exact k6 commands so I can add to the runbook?

leo_sre: k6 snippets below. We'll run against staging with X-Shadow-Account header.

leo_sre: ```
# shadow run (20m @60%)
k6 run --vus 120 --duration 20m loadtests/acme-shadow.js \
  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  --tag run=acme-seatbelt-shadow-60 --tag phase=shadow --header "X-Shadow-Account: acme" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086

# smoke (10m @100%)
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m loadtests/acme-smoke.js \
  --env TARGET=https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  --tag run=acme-seatbelt-smoke-100 --tag phase=smoke --header "X-Shadow-Account: acme" --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```

maria_cs: Thanks. Also scheduling a 30m pre-run sync at 07:30 PDT for final checks and a 30m post-run debrief. Invite sent.

deploy-bot: reserved pool create started for request acme-seatbelt.

deploy-bot: reserved pool created (id: rp-9927). Autoscale policy `seatbelt-acme-v1` attached.

raj_infra: rp-9927 up. I'll leave hard quota disabled initially and enable it 15m after shadow completes. Soft-cap will be enforced via throttling headers.

leo_sre: Oncall for the window: leo_sre primary, raj_infra secondary. I'll bump trace retention to 21d for this run and enable detailed span sampling.

anya_ops: For enablement feedback, can the CS rep share the short survey link in the post-run? We'll attach to renewal notes.

maria_cs: Will do. Also collecting qualitative notes from Product during the post-run call.

leo_sre: Add rollback rule: if error_rate > 1.5% and p95 > 700ms over 3 windows of 60s, switch traffic to fallback model and scale down pool to safe floor.

raj_infra: Note on billing signals: we will capture cost-per-1k-tokens during shadow and compare to baseline. I'll push cost metric to billing dashboard.

maria_cs: Summary: pool rp-9927, policy seatbelt-acme-v1, shadow 20m@60% -> smoke 10m@100%, pre-run 07:30 PDT, oncall leo/raj, tag runs acme-seatbelt-2026, soft cap during shadow, hard cap 15m post-shadow. I'll post results and CSV. Good luck. :thumbsup:

anya_ops: :thumbsup: Ping me if any escalation.

leo_sre: See you tomorrow.

(End of thread)
